lines.en: label yasuchristmalloween2:
scene yasumcdonalds1
: Sensei?...Why are we at McDonald’s?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……我们为什么在 McDonald's？……

lines.en: : That’s a question for Ayane, not me. {i}I{/i} wanted to leave you at the party and try to un-fuck this timeline.
lines.zh: : 这个问题该问 Ayane，别问我。{i}我{/i}本来想把你留在派对上，然后去把这时间线修好。

lines.en: : Because I’m unworthy of your attention and make everything worse by merely being involved?
lines.zh: : 因为我不配得到你的注意，只要牵扯上我就只会把事情弄得更糟？

lines.en: : No. Because this timeline is extremely fucked up and no one even remembers that Christmas exists all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 不是。因为这条时间线乱得一塌糊涂，而且所有人突然都不记得圣诞节的存在了。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t say bad words. Your tongue could catch on fire and then everything would taste like pain for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 你不该说脏话。你的舌头可能会着火，然后你这辈子尝到的每样东西都会是痛苦的味道。

lines.en: : Does “pain” have a flavor now?
lines.zh: : 「痛苦」现在有味道了吗？

lines.en: : Like fermented maggots left out to cook in the sun on a hot summer day- their wriggling slowly being cut down by celestial rays of fire that pour from the mouth of a star like-
lines.zh: : 像发酵的蛆虫，在大热天被摊在太阳底下烤——它们的蠕动被从星星嘴里倾泻而下的天界火焰一点点切断，就像——

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. That sounds pretty terrible. So I’ll try to be a little less abrasive from now on if that’s what will make you happy.
lines.zh: : 好，好。听起来确实很糟。那么从现在起我尽量不那么刺人，如果那样能让你开心的话。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds2
: Thank you. And I’m sorry again for making you waste your time on me. You should be safe from divine intervention now that I’ve had my medicine.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。还有，再次抱歉让你把时间浪费在我身上。既然我吃过药了，你现在应该不用担心什么神圣干预了。

lines.en: : I think most of us are more concerned about {i}your{/i} safety when you do things like that than our own. We know you’re not going to hurt us.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们大多数人更担心的是{i}你{/i}的安全——你做那种事的时候。我们知道你不会伤害我们。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds3
: But why would anyone be concerned about {i}my{/i} safety?
lines.zh: : 可为什么会有人担心{i}我{/i}的安全？

lines.en: : I’m safe within the arms of God. And no one likes me to begin with. They think I’m scary.
lines.zh: : 我在上帝的怀抱里很安全。而且一开始就没有人喜欢我。他们觉得我很吓人。

lines.en: : No one thinks you’re scary, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 没人觉得你吓人，Yasu。

lines.en: : But I can hear their thoughts sometimes and all of those thoughts are about how scary I am. Or about how desperately they long for the light that you produce.
lines.zh: : 但我有时能听见他们的想法，而那些想法全都是关于我有多吓人。或者是关于他们有多渴望你散发出的那道光。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds4
: Though, their words concerning that last part are typically a lot more vulgar and make me want to shut my brain off.
lines.zh: : 不过，关于后面那部分的措辞通常粗俗得多，让我想把自己的脑子关掉。

lines.en: : We all want to shut our brain off sometimes. Not everyone welcomes those {i}voices{/i} you hear. But I guess not everyone gets them to begin with. And suddenly I am envious.
lines.zh: : 我们都有想把自己脑子关掉的时候。不是每个人都欢迎你听见的那些{i}声音{/i}。不过我想，也不是每个人一开始就有。这么一想我倒嫉妒了。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds5
: Even fewer have visions. So what I tirelessly struggle to understand is how {i}you{/i} seem to fit in more than I do despite being even more “special.”
lines.zh: : 有异象的人更少。所以我百思不得其解的是：明明你比我更「特别」，为什么{i}你{/i}看起来却比我更合群。

lines.en: : Well, for one, I can’t predict the future. So I think people might get a little uncomfortable around you since {i}you{/i} can. They don’t want to know what comes next.
lines.zh: : 首先，我无法预言未来。所以人们在你身边可能会有点不自在，因为{i}你{/i}能。他们不想知道接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds6
: Is that really what I’m doing, though?...
lines.zh: : 可我真的在做那件事吗？……

lines.en: : Are the things I hear and messages I receive {i}really{/i} premonitions? Or just echoes of the past that circled the divine globe and found their way to me far too late?
lines.zh: : 我听见的那些声音、收到的那些信息，{i}真的{/i}是预兆吗？还是只是绕着神圣的球体转了一圈、太晚才找到我的过去的回声？

lines.en: : Given that the past doesn’t make a sound, I’m going to go with the former. But I guess you can never really know in a place like this.
lines.zh: : 既然过去发不出声音，我选前者。不过我想，在这种地方你永远没法真正确定。

lines.en: : I don’t like it...
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这样……

lines.en: : Without the voices to tell me where I am, I often forget. And when I forget, I’m scared too.
lines.zh: : 没有那些声音告诉我身在何处，我常常会忘。而当我忘的时候，我也会害怕。

lines.en: : So maybe I’m more like a moth than I am a roach or worm — constantly heading toward the light because it’s the only thing I know. The only thing that keeps me warm.
lines.zh: : 所以也许我更像一只飞蛾，而不是蟑螂或虫子——不断朝光飞去，因为那是我唯一知道的东西。唯一能让我暖和的东西。

lines.en: : Well, whatever you are, it doesn’t really matter to me. Medication or not, I don’t intend to leave you behind. Even {i}when{/i} you get annoying and scary.
lines.zh: : 不管你是什么，对我来说其实都无所谓。吃不吃药，我都不打算丢下你。{i}哪怕{/i}你变得又烦人又吓人。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds7
: Both you and Touka are far too kind to me. I’ve done nothing to deserve this.
lines.zh: : 你和 Touka 都对我太好了。我没做过什么配得上这些的事。

lines.en: : Not everything needs to be deserved. Hasn’t your God taught you to treat others the way you wish to be treated? I thought that was a common denominator in, like...{i}every{/i} religion.
lines.zh: : 不是什么都需要配得上。你的上帝没教过你——你希望别人怎么待你，你就怎么待人吗？我以为那是，呃……{i}所有{/i}宗教的共同点。

lines.en: : I was taught to think not of what I stand to gain, but what I can obtain for Him. Chasing after things that only benefit me does nothing for the greater good.
lines.zh: : 我被教的不是去想自己能得到什么，而是能为祂争取到什么。追逐只对我有利的东西，对更大的善毫无用处。

lines.en: : So we’re all just tools for you to strengthen your connection to God then?
lines.zh: : 所以我们都只是你用来加强与上帝联系的工具咯？

lines.en: : You are bugs, the same way I am. Small, ugly, pathetic creatures who will surely fade away without the help of something more powerful. I just want to save you.
lines.zh: : 你们是虫子，跟我一样。渺小、丑陋、可悲的生物，没有更强大的存在的帮助，注定会消散。我只是想拯救你们。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 但是……

lines.en: : I also think I {i}like{/i} bugs.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得我{i}喜欢{/i}虫子。

lines.en: : They’re interesting. Easier to understand. So easy that, sometimes, I can do it without even trying.
lines.zh: : 它们很有趣。更容易理解。简单到我有时甚至不用费力就能懂。

lines.en: : They don’t sin. They don’t understand malice or scorn. They’re just so...simple. And act on instinct. But this normally means that they run away before I even get the chance to say hi.
lines.zh: : 它们不犯罪。它们不懂恶意，也不懂轻蔑。它们就那么……单纯。凭本能行动。但这通常意味着，我还没来得及打招呼，它们就跑掉了。

lines.en: : So, yes. To answer your question, you {i}are{/i} tools that I must use to carve a path for He Who Lost His Sight. But you are {i}more{/i} than that too.
lines.zh: : 所以，{i}是{/i}的。回答你的问题：你们是我必须用来为「失明者」开路的工具。但你们也{i}不止于此{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, that just means {i}you{/i} are as well then.
lines.zh: : 那这就意味着{i}你{/i}也不止于此。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I think so.
lines.zh: : 有时我也这么想。

lines.en: : Others, I feel more like a cocoon.
lines.zh: : 另一些时候，我觉得自己更像个茧。

lines.en: if harukachristmalloween1 == True:
Suddenly, my phone begins to vibrate. What perfect timing too — as Yasu now seems locked in one more bout of spiritual contemplation.
lines.zh: 突然，我的手机开始震动。时机也太巧了——Yasu 这会儿似乎又陷入了一阵灵性冥想。

lines.en: : One second, Yasu. I need to answer this.
lines.zh: : 等一下，Yasu。我得接个电话。

lines.en: : I wonder if that will ever happen to me.
lines.zh: : 我在想，这种事会不会发生在我身上。

lines.en: : Wonder if...what? If you’ll get a text message?
lines.zh: : 想什么……？想你会收到短信？

lines.en: : Mm. I’m not supposed to concern myself with material things though.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过我不该去关心物质的东西。

lines.en: : Concern yourself with whatever makes {i}you{/i} happy. Living for someone else sucks.
lines.zh: : 去关心让{i}你{/i}开心的东西就行。为别人而活很糟糕。

lines.en: scene black
jump harukachristmalloweennude
else:
jump restofyasumallow
label restofyasumallow:
: Okay! Sorry. I’m back.
lines.zh: : 好了！抱歉。我回来了。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds8
: The ice cream machine was broken and Geoffrey wasn’t available to come fix it on such short notice. So I just ran to the convenience store and got these instead.
lines.zh: : 冰淇淋机坏了，Geoffrey 又没法随叫随到地来修。所以我就跑去便利店买了这些。

lines.en: : I’m just thankful it’s Halloween since I’m supposed to be banned from that one and I don’t think they recognized me.
lines.zh: : 还好今天是万圣节，因为我本来被那家店拉黑了，我想他们没认出我。

lines.en: : Halloween?...
lines.zh: : 万圣节？……

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds9
: Oh, right. Sorry. {i}Christ{/i}malloween. The...totally real holiday that has always existed and isn’t just a symptom of some weird butterfly effect thing.
lines.zh: : 哦对。抱歉。{i}圣诞{/i}万圣节。那个……一直都存在的、绝对真实的节日，才不是什么奇怪的蝴蝶效应的症状呢。

lines.en: : Good cover. That sounded really natural, Ayane. Why are there only two ice cream cones?
lines.zh: : 掩护得不错。听起来真自然，Ayane。为什么只有两个冰淇淋蛋筒？

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds10
: So I can make you lick mine.
lines.zh: : 这样我才能让你舔我的。

lines.en: : I am suddenly not hungry anymore.
lines.zh: : 我突然不饿了。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds11
: So! What’d you guys talk about while I was gone? Does Yasu’s transcendent memory bank hold any of the secrets that we’re looking for?
lines.zh: : 那么！我不在的时候你们聊了什么？Yasu 那超越性的记忆库里，有没有存着我们要找的秘密？

lines.en: : Do we even {i}know{/i} what secrets we’re looking for yet? Or just that Maya and Ami have something to do with it?
lines.zh: : 我们到底知不{i}知道{/i}自己在找什么秘密？还是只知道 Maya 和 Ami 跟这事有关？

lines.en: : Something to do with what? I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 跟什么有关？我糊涂了。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds12
: Oh, and thank you for the ice cream. I will pay you back once Touka allows me to carry my own money.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，谢谢你的冰淇淋。等 Touka 允许我自己带钱了，我会还你的。

lines.en: : No need! I’m rich too and spending money helps me spite my dad. So if there’s anything {i}else{/i} you want, feel free to tell me about that too!
lines.zh: : 不用还！我也很有钱，花钱能气到我爸。所以要是你还想要{i}别的{/i}，尽管跟我说！

lines.en: : She’s not allowed to long for material goods or her god will turn her into a sun-cooked maggot or something like that.
lines.zh: : 她不被允许渴望物质的东西，不然她的神会把她变成太阳烤熟的蛆虫之类的。

lines.en: : Close enough. But I must regretfully inform you that my memory is not “transcendent” as you’ve said. I merely relay information from the texts of His eternal diary.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。不过我得遗憾地告诉你，我的记忆并不像你说的那样「超越性」。我只是转述祂永恒日记文本里的信息。

lines.en: : Then, do you happen to know anything about the world repeating itself?
lines.zh: : 那么，你知不知道关于世界在重复自身的事？

lines.en: : I must regretfully inform you that my memory is not “transcendent” as you’ve said. I merely relay information from the texts of His eternal diary.
lines.zh: : 我得遗憾地告诉你，我的记忆并不像你说的那样「超越性」。我只是转述祂永恒日记文本里的信息。

lines.en: : Welp, guess that answers {i}that{/i} question.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，那就算回答了{i}那个{/i}问题吧。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds13
: I’m sorry I cannot be of more assistance. All I know is what I am {i}permitted{/i} to know. Everything else is waste.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我帮不上更多忙。我只知道我{i}被允许{/i}知道的东西。其余的都是废物。

lines.en: : Maybe we just need to ask in a...more roundabout way? Like — hey, Yasu. Does “His eternal diary” happen to have any notes on Maya being the origin of the world?
lines.zh: : 也许我们该用更……委婉的方式问？比如——嘿，Yasu。「祂的永恒日记」里有没有提到 Maya 是世界的起源？

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds14
: Merely theorizing about the formation of the world is heresy when we already know it was Nozomu who created everything.
lines.zh: : 既然我们已经知道一切是 Nozomu 创造的，光是去推测世界的形成就是异端。

lines.en: scene norikobrother19
scene yasumcdonalds14
: Akira? Are you o-
lines.zh: : Akira？你还好——

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m fine. Just a...flash-headache, I guess. Nothing to be concerned about.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我没事。只是……一阵突然的头痛，我想。没什么好担心的。

lines.en: : What would lead you to believe that Maya has something to do with the creation of this world? Is she not a normal teenage girl?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会觉得 Maya 跟这个世界的创造有关？她不是个普通的十几岁女孩吗？

lines.en: : Well...Ayane and I just sort of...felt like she was relevant for no good reason today. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我和 Ayane 就是……今天莫名觉得她很关键。就这样。

lines.en: : What about Ami then? Does your weird brain diary mention anything about-
lines.zh: : 那 Ami 呢？你那本奇怪的大脑日记有没有提到——

lines.en: : I think we can rule her out for the time being, actually.
lines.zh: : 我觉得暂时可以把她排除。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds15
: Really? So she didn’t have anything to say when you confronted her earlier?
lines.zh: : 真的？那你之前跟她对质时，她什么都没说？

lines.en: : Nope. Just more...Ami stuff. You know. Incest. Things like that.
lines.zh: : 没有。只是更多……Ami 那套。你知道的。乱伦之类的。

lines.en: : Aah! Maggot tongue!
lines.zh: : 啊！蛆虫舌头！

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds16
: Maggot tongue?
lines.zh: : 蛆虫舌头？

lines.en: : Right. {i}That’s{/i} where the sun-cooked maggot thing comes from.
lines.zh: : 对。「太阳烤熟的蛆虫」{i}就是{/i}这么来的。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds17
: Regardless, I’m glad she’s not involved. That definitely makes {i}me{/i} feel a little better, at least.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我很高兴她没牵扯进来。至少这让{i}我{/i}好受一点。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds18
: Because if she’d known about any of this and was just pretending {i}not{/i} to for my sake, I don’t really know how I’d handle it.
lines.zh: : 因为如果她知道这一切，却为了我装作{i}不知道{/i}，我真不知道自己会怎么面对。

lines.en: : Anyway, Yasu! There’s gotta be some sort of apocalyptic premonition in whatever your religious texts are, right?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，Yasu！不管你的宗教经典是什么，里面总该有些关于末日的预言吧？

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds19
: Oh, yes. Many. The end of days is upon us.
lines.zh: : 哦，有。很多。末日已经迫在眉睫。

lines.en: : It {i}sure{/i} is. And the key to salvation is what again?
lines.zh: : {i}确实{/i}是。那么拯救的关键是什么来着？

lines.en: : Transference. The recycling of light from man to woman to God.
lines.zh: : 传递。光从男人到女人、再到上帝的循环。

lines.en: : In Japanese, please?
lines.zh: : 能说人话吗？

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds20
: He needs to splooge inside of us.
lines.zh: : 祂得射在我们里面。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds21
: Oh, yay. Then I guess we’re already saved.
lines.zh: : 哦，好耶。那我们大概已经得救了。

lines.en: : Surely it’s more complicated than {i}just{/i} that, though. Right, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 不过肯定不止{i}这么简单{/i}吧。对吧，Yasu？

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds22
: Correct. Upon receiving light from one who was chosen, females must {i}deliver{/i} that light to God through a spiritual linking ritual in which the light is extracted from us.
lines.zh: : 没错。女性从被选中者那里接受光之后，必须通过一场灵性连接仪式把那道光{i}交给{/i}上帝——在仪式中，光会从我们体内被取出。

lines.en: : Ew...So does he just go in there with a vacuum or something?
lines.zh: : 呃……那祂就拿着吸尘器进去吸吗还是怎样？

lines.en: : I am not sure, for this body is just as pure as the moment it was born. But from what I understand, it is a feeling that transcends even the act of {i}receiving{/i} the light in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我不确定，因为这具身体还跟刚出生时一样纯洁。但据我所知，那是一种甚至超越了「{i}接受{/i}光」本身的感觉。

lines.en: : Well, that doesn’t sound so bad. So how do we do this ritual thing then? I’ve received plenty of light. Your God would be happy to have me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，听起来也不算太糟。那这个仪式要怎么做？我可接收过不少光了。你的上帝会很乐意收我的。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds23
: You’re actually...interested?
lines.zh: : 你真的……有兴趣？

lines.en: : You’re actually {i}interested?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你真的{i}有兴趣{/i}？

lines.en: : It couldn’t hurt to try, right? Like, we’ve gotten the hard part out of the way a zillion times already. The worst thing that can happen is just...nothing.
lines.zh: : 试试也没坏处吧？反正最难的那部分我们已经做过无数次了。最坏的结果也不过是……什么都没发生。

lines.en: : Ayane, are you forgetting that gods actually {i}exist{/i} in this world? We can’t keep denying them when we’ve seen them ourselves.
lines.zh: : Ayane，你忘了这世上神是真的{i}存在{/i}的吗？我们亲眼见过，不能再否认了。

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds24
: So then...{i}she{/i} has seen the visage as well? But I don’t...no. No, that can’t be true. I’d have heard something.
lines.zh: : 那么……{i}她{/i}也见过那面容？可我……不。不，这不可能。我该听见点什么的。

lines.en: : I’ve seen {i}a{/i} visage. Or...{i}visages.{/i} But maybe it’s not the one you’re thinking of?
lines.zh: : 我见过{i}一个{/i}面容。或者……{i}几个{/i}。不过也许不是你想的那个？

lines.en: : But there is only one. There can only be {i}one.{/i} What else have you {i}seen?{/i}
lines.zh: : 但只有一个。只能有{i}一个{/i}。你还{i}看见{/i}了什么？

lines.en: : Yasu, they’re visions. We can’t explain them. They come out of nowhere, leave, and more than half the time, we can’t even remember what we saw.
lines.zh: : Yasu，那是异象。我们解释不了。它们凭空出现，又离开，而且多半时候我们连自己看见了什么都不记得。

lines.en: : That’s something your god would be able to find out if he vacuumed the light out of me though, right? Then he could...tell you about it? Is that how it works?
lines.zh: : 不过这种事，你的神只要把光从我身上吸出来就能查到吧？然后他就能……告诉你？是这么运作的吗？

lines.en: scene yasumcdonalds25
: We...that...
lines.zh: : 我们……那个……

lines.en: : I’m not sure, but...
